claim: The note says the sentence stacks three に with different jobs, but the sentence has only two.
evidence: Target: スミスさんはげつようびの４じにとうきょうえきですずきさんにあいます (に after ４じ, に after すずきさん). Note: "person は — day/time に — place で — target に — verb, stacking three に's with different jobs in one sentence." The note's own word order lists two に.
fix: Change "three に's" to "two に's" (time and target), or say it puts this lesson's target に beside Lesson 7's time に.

claim: The note says つま is "also read" かない, as if they were one word, but the かない card treats them as two different words.
evidence: tsuma-wife note: "Also read かない (kanai) — both mean 'my wife'". kanai-wife note: "A humble word for one's own wife, literally \"inside the house\". つま is the everyday modern word; かない sounds dated". Hints: "the everyday modern word" / "the older, more traditional word".
fix: Say "かない (kanai) is an older word with the same meaning" instead of "Also read".

claim: The note says おっと is "also read" しゅじん, as if they were one word, but the しゅじん card gives it its own meaning, "literally master".
evidence: otto-husband note: "Also read しゅじん (shujin) — both mean 'my husband'". shujin-husband hint: "the more traditional word, literally \"master\""; note: "A traditional word for one's own husband ... おっと is the neutral modern equivalent."
fix: Say "しゅじん (shujin) is a more traditional word with the same meaning" instead of "Also read".

claim: The Production front "Beverage" and the extras card drink's front "Drink" ask for the same noun, and nothing tells me when to add the お.
evidence: chapter-9/onomimono Production front: "Beverage" (no hint), answer おのみもの. chapter-9-extras/drink Production front: "Drink / the noun, a thing you drink", answer のみもの. Both notes say the お is the polite restaurant form, but neither front asks for politeness.
fix: Give onomimono a hint such as "the polite form a restaurant uses", and give drink a hint such as "plain, without お".

claim: The front does not tell me to answer with the short にします, so I would say the full でんわをします sentence.
evidence: Production front: "He'll call Nakamura-san. / answering whom Smith-san will telephone", answer なかむらさんにします. The sibling card chapter-9-extras/ex9-ginko-ni-shimasu has the hint "The reply keeps only します (shimasu, \"do\"), short for でんわをします"; this card has none, and no note explains the shortening.
fix: Add the same hint as ex9-ginko-ni-shimasu, or a note saying the reply drops でんわを.

claim: "Two bottles of beer, please." fits ください as well as おねがいします, and this chapter uses the same English shape for both.
evidence: Production front: "Two bottles of beer, please.", answer ビールを２ほんおねがいします. Ledger: ビールを３ぼんください "Three beers, please.". This chapter's extras: v9-gurasu-o-futatsu "Two wine glasses, please." is グラスをふたつください.
fix: Word the English "I'd like two bottles of beer, please." (the deck's おねがいします cue elsewhere) or add a hint naming おねがいします.

claim: The Recognition hint says what や means, and I know no other や it needs to be told apart from.
evidence: Recognition front: "や / attached to what a shop sells, naming the shop"; answer: "(suffix for shop or restaurant)". No や appears in the ledger.
fix: Drop the Recognition hint, or replace it with an example frame such as てんぷら＿.

claim: The Recognition hint contains the answer word "language".
evidence: Recognition front: "ご / naming a language after a country name"; answer: "Language". A hint is needed because ご is also 5 and the honorific prefix, but this one states the answer.
fix: Use an example frame instead, such as "after a country name, as in にほん＿".

claim: The Recognition hint is the answer in different words.
evidence: Recognition front: "に / marking who a call, e-mail or greeting is aimed at"; answer: "(particle marking the person or thing an action is directed at)". A hint is needed (に is also direction and time), but this one states the function being asked for.
fix: Use a frame such as "たなかさん＿あいます" so the front picks the sense without naming it.

claim: The Production front shows the scene and the hint as two lines that say nearly the same thing.
evidence: Production front: "Ask / getting information from a person / getting information from a person, not listening to audio".
fix: Keep one of the two lines (the hint, which also rules out 'listen').

claim: Several notes point to cards by position ("above", "below", "the previous card"), which means nothing in a shuffled deck.
evidence: tell-phone-number: "Contrasts with the previous card"; ask-phone-number: "vs おしえます (oshiemasu, 'tell') below"; mainichi-everyday: "まいしゅう ... below"; okusan: "つま (tsuma) below"; goshujin: "おっと (otto) below"; okurimasu-send: "おしえます ... above"; maiasa, maiban: "まいにち ... above". The extras card fib-gakko-de-nihongo-o-oshiemasu says "the earlier example".
fix: Name the card instead ("see the まいにち card", "compare なかむらさんはスミスさんにでんわばんごうをおしえました").

claim: Nothing on the Production front asks for the contrastive は after せんしゅう, so I would leave it out.

claim: The card drops the を of べんきょうをします without saying so, so I would say にほんごをべんきょうをします.
